notes.title: Significant level updates
notes.notes:
Hello Button VR players,

We're excited to announce that we've just released an update to the game, featuring new content and improvements based on your feedback. Here's a rundown of what's new in this update:

We've made significant updates to levels 9, 18, 20, 23, 27, 28, 29, 30, 37, and 39, based on your feedback. We've adjusted the difficulty, layout, and puzzles of these levels to make them more engaging and challenging.

We've optimized the game's graphics and rendering to improve performance on a wider range of hardware, making the game more accessible to players with lower-end machines.

We've reduced the game's loading times, so you can get into the action faster and spend more time playing.

We've addressed various bugs and glitches that were reported by players, including issues with puzzles not functioning correctly or the game crashing during play.

We've also made adjustments to the game's audio and visual effects to ensure they're working correctly and providing the intended immersive experience

Thank you for your support and feedback, and we hope you enjoy the new content and improvements in this update. As always, please feel free to share your feedback and suggestions with us, as we're always looking to improve the game and make it the best it can be.
